text: dsh-ecc-skills 是面向 DSH 的 Cordis 技能提供者，把随包分发的 ECC 技能接入 host 层技能注册表，供各 agent preset 的技能范围发现和按需加载。技能覆盖工程方法、代码与框架模式、测试评估、agent 协作、研究以及医疗、金融、设计等领域；提供者扫描技能目录读取 frontmatter，用户调用时再返回完整内容。适合希望在 DSH 中复用成体系工作流程指南的开发者与 agent。需要兼容 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 及以上版本；插件本身无需额外配置。

dsh-ecc-skills adds ECC skills to DSH through a Cordis provider. It discovers packaged metadata and loads definitions on demand. Skills cover engineering, coding patterns, testing, agent collaboration, research, and specialist areas. Requires DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 or later, with no extra configuration.
想给 DSH 加一套覆盖多种开发场景的技能指南。
有没有能让 agent 按步骤做代码评估和回归检查的工作流？
我想让多个 agent 用清晰的任务归属和合并门槛协同开发。
怎样在 DSH 里按需加载工程实践或框架开发指导？
需要一个能指导多来源资料研究并整理引用报告的技能。
I want reusable engineering workflows that my DSH agents can load when needed.
How can I guide an agent squad with ownership, Kanban states, and merge gates?
I need a skill that helps synthesize multi-source research into cited reports.
dsh-ecc-skills 提供「eval-first 工程流程」技能：在实施前定义能力与回归评估，记录基线，再执行并比较结果。可用于希望 agent 按可衡量完成标准推进工程任务的场景。
dsh-ecc-skills 提供「agent 团队编排」技能：用工作项、负责人、看板状态、分支隔离和合并门槛组织 agent 小组。适合需要跨会话追踪协作进度并确保交付可合并的项目。
dsh-ecc-skills 提供「多来源深度研究」技能：通过 Firecrawl 或 Exa MCP 搜索资料、综合发现并生成带来源归属的报告。使用前需在宿主配置至少一种对应 MCP 工具。
dsh-ecc-skills 提供「MCP 服务端模式」技能：指导开发者组织工具、资源、提示模板及 stdio 或 Streamable HTTP 传输。适用于实现、升级或排查 MCP 服务端时查阅。
dsh-ecc-skills 提供「TasteForge 视频风格工作流」技能：指导用户访谈提炼审美方向、整理并校验 style pack，再将节奏和视觉规则应用到本地媒体并导出可编辑时间线。

dsh-ecc-skills README · Port status: 274 / 286 skills (95.8%)：- **v0.1.0** ✅ 20 skills — engineering methodology, agent systems, foundations
- **v0.2.0** ✅ 68 skills — framework/language patterns (react, vue, django,
  laravel, springboot, quarkus, kotlin, swift, go, rust, ...), data &
  architecture
- **v0.3.0** ✅ 50 skills — orchestration/automation/ops (orch-* six-pack,
  council, dev-team, e2e-testing, browser-qa, repo-scan, benchmark series,
  budget advisors, canary-watch, production-audit, ...)
- **v0.4.0** ✅ 135 skills — vertical domains (healthcare, homelab, scientific,
  finance, design/content, network ops, supply chain, marketing, research &
  data)
- **v0.5.0 (this release)** ✅ +1 skill — `tasteforge-video` (repeatable
  taste-driven video workflow: taste interview → style pack → validate → apply
  → editable EDL/FCPXML export; ported from upstream 2026-08-18 commit 9c45004)
- **Not ported (12)**: 6 skills depending on `/ecc:*` commands/hooks
  (ecc-guide, ecc-recipes, gateguard, plan-orchestrate, strategic-compact,
  continuous-learning-v2) and 6 with companion files — unless a hooks/commands
  bridge layer is built later.

dsh-ecc-skills README · Adaptation notes：- `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` copied verbatim (standard format, frontmatter carries
  `metadata.origin: ECC`).
- Zero harness-specific references in all 274 ported skills; only 2 command
  references were renamed to DSH bare names in v0.1 (`/bug-check` →
  `bug-check`, `/prompt-optimize` → `prompt-optimizer`).
- Skill identity comes from the frontmatter `name` (e.g. the five
  `scientific-*` directories expose `pubmed-database`, `uspto-database`,
  `gget`, `literature-review`, `scholar-evaluation`).
- All skills model+user invocable. Provider parses folded YAML frontmatter
  natively; zero runtime dependencies.

dsh-ecc-skills README · How it works / adding skills：Host-layer `ctx.skills.registerProvider` (same pattern as
[mattpocock-skills-dsh](https://github.com/gongyijie85/mattpocock-skills-dsh)).
Drop a `skills/<kebab-name>/SKILL.md` and it is auto-discovered. Verify with
`npm run verify` (274/274).
